description: This source file defines the PlacementFilterStrategyResolver class responsible for resolving placement filter strategies for grain types within Orleans runtime. It manages caching, resolution, and initialization of filter strategies based on grain properties and dependencies.

classes.name: PlacementFilterStrategyResolver
classes.description: Resolver for determining applicable placement filter strategies for a given GrainType in Orleans, with internal caching and dependency resolution.

methods.name: PlacementFilterStrategyResolver
methods.description: Constructor initializing the resolver with required services and grain properties resolver.

methods.name: GetPlacementFilterStrategies
methods.description: Retrieves or computes the collection of placement filter strategies associated with a specified GrainType.

methods.name: GetPlacementFilterStrategyInternal
methods.description: Internal method that performs the actual resolution and initialization of placement filter strategies based on grain properties and configuration.
